es: Escribir una explicación de una situación inesperada indicando lo que ya había sucedido.

teaching.en: I was surprised to discover that the class had already finished.
teaching.es: Me sorprendió descubrir que la clase ya había terminado.
teaching.explanationEs: Discover + that + oración: lo descubierto va con had + participio si ya había pasado.

teaching.audioText: I was surprised to discover that the class had already finished.

teaching.en: Unfortunately, the shop had closed an hour before I got there.
teaching.es: Por desgracia, la tienda había cerrado una hora antes de que yo llegara.
teaching.explanationEs: Unfortunately abre el problema; had closed es lo que pasó antes de llegar.

teaching.en: Everyone had gone home, and the room was completely empty.

teaching.explanationEs: Had gone es el antecedente; was empty describe lo que viste.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Descubrí que la clase ya había terminado.»

answer.text: I discovered that the class had already finished

feedback.es: Primero el sujeto y el verbo de descubrir; después that y la acción anterior con had already finished.

hint.es: Empieza con I discovered that y termina con el participio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando llegué, descubrí que todos se habían ido a casa.»

feedback.es: Had gone es el past perfect de go: todos se fueron antes de que yo llegara.

hint.es: Es el participio irregular del verbo ir.

origin.text: When I arrived, I discovered that everyone had ___ home.

prompt.es: Elige la frase completa: «Descubrí que la tienda ya había cerrado.»

choices.text: I discovered that the shop already closed.
I discovered that the shop had already closed.
Discovered that the shop had already closed.

feedback.es: Hay que decir el sujeto (I) y usar had + participio para lo que ya había ocurrido; en inglés no se omite el sujeto.

hint.es: Incluye el sujeto y had + participio.

prompt.es: Escribe la frase en inglés con discover.

answer.text: I discovered that the concert had finished.
accepted: I discovered that the concert had finished.
I discovered that the concert had already finished.
I discovered that the concert had ended.

feedback.es: Se escribe I discovered that + sujeto + had + participio: el concierto terminó antes del descubrimiento.

origin.text: Frase: descubrí que el concierto había terminado.

prompt.es: Completa: «La tienda había cerrado. No me di cuenta de que había leído mal la fecha.»

feedback.es: La primera frase necesita had para lo anterior; la segunda, realise: darse cuenta de que había leído mal.

prompt.es: Escribe el relato completo: llegada, descubrimiento y motivo (unas 40 palabras).

answer.text: Last Saturday I went to the cinema with my friend. When we got to the cinema, we discovered that the film had already started. Unfortunately, I had read the wrong time on the poster. Everyone had gone inside, so we went home.
accepted: Last Saturday I went to the cinema with my friend. When we got to the cinema, we discovered that the film had already started. Unfortunately, I had read the wrong time on the poster. Everyone had gone inside, so we went home.

On Saturday my friend and I went to the cinema. When we arrived, we realised that the film had already begun, because I had read the wrong time on the poster. Unfortunately, everyone had gone inside, so we went back home.

Last Saturday I went to the cinema with a friend. When I got there, I found out that the film had started an hour before. I had read the wrong time on the poster. Everyone had gone in, so we went home.

feedback.es: Un buen relato llega, descubre lo anterior con had + participio, explica el motivo y cuenta qué hicisteis después.

origin.text: Relato: el sábado fuiste al cine con un amigo. Al llegar, descubriste que la película ya había empezado porque habías leído mal la hora en el cartel. Por desgracia, todos habían entrado ya, así que volvisteis a casa.

feedback.es: La biblioteca cerró a las cuatro, antes de que Sara llegara a las cinco; por eso va con had already closed.

origin.text: Sara got to the library at five. It closed at four.
